name: Just a simulation
detailed_description:
Just a Simulation is a top-down, sci-fi incremental shooter where you take on the role of an operator tasked with dismantling enemy systems, one tile at a time. With a sleek futuristic user interface and a minimalist aesthetic, you’ll unleash devastating weapons, hack into enemy networks, and strategically destroy everything in your path.

Key Features:

  • Destruction at Scale: Wreak havoc on enemy systems by destroying tiles, shields, patrols, structures, etc. Each level is a puzzle of destruction, where every shot counts.

  • Incremental Progression: Unlock powerful weapons, upgrades, and abilities as you progress. Customize your arsenal to suit your playstyle, from precision lasers to chaotic flak cannon barrages.

  • Dynamic Missions: Tackle a variety of objectives, from total annihilation to stealthy data extraction. Protect cores, trigger chain reactions, and survive waves of enemies.

  • Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a sleek world inspired by sci-fi user interfaces.

  • Deep Mechanics: Master a wide range of weapons and abilities.

What Makes It Unique?

  • God’s-Eye View: Command the battlefield from above, strategizing and executing your attacks with precision.

  • Incremental Gameplay: The more you destroy, the stronger you become. But the challenges grow tougher, forcing you to adapt and optimize.

  • Tactical Depth: Every level is a sandbox of destruction, where your choices determine success or failure. Will you go in guns blazing, or hack your way to victory?

Who Is This Game For?

  • Fans of incremental games who love seeing their power grow over time.

  • Players who enjoy top-down shooters with a strategic twist.

  • Sci-fi enthusiasts who appreciate futuristic aesthetics and thought-provoking narratives.

  • Anyone who’s ever wondered: What if I could just destroy everything?
